sentences.en: I was wondering if you could cover for me at the client call.
I'll send you my notes so you can get up to speed.
Thanks for the heads-up, by the way.
Sorry to bother you. Do you have a minute?
I was wondering if you could cover for me on Friday.
Would it be possible to go through it together tomorrow?
Thank you so much. I owe you one.
I was wondering if you could cover for me on Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 不知道你週五下午能不能幫我代班。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to get the file by Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 請問星期三前可以拿到檔案嗎？

sentences.en: Would you mind looping in the finance team?
sentences.zh: 可以麻煩你把財務團隊加進來嗎？

sentences.en: I was wondering if you could cover for me next Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 不知道你下週二能不能幫我代班？

sentences.en: Would it be possible to send me the report by Friday? No rush.
sentences.zh: 請問星期五前可以把報告寄給我嗎？不急。

sentences.en: Thanks for the heads-up. I owe you one!
sentences.zh: 謝謝你先提醒我，欠你一次！

sentences.en: I know you're slammed, but could I steal you for literally two minutes?
I can't for the life of me figure out why.
Would it be possible to send it over now?
Overall, we're still on track for the December launch.
We started it on Wednesday, but we've fallen a bit behind.
We've asked them for the new API keys twice, and we still haven't heard back.
We've finished the homepage, and the client signed off on the design last Thursday.
The real blocker right now is the payment provider.
We can still wrap up testing before the end of the month.
We have finished the homepage, but we haven't started the checkout page yet.
sentences.zh: 首頁已經完成了，但結帳頁還沒開始做。

sentences.en: The client approved the design on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 客戶星期二批准了設計。

sentences.en: I've sent three reminders this week, and he finally replied an hour ago.
sentences.zh: 我這週已經寄了三次提醒，他一小時前終於回了。

sentences.en: The client approved the design last Thursday.
sentences.zh: 客戶上週四批准了設計。

sentences.en: Overall, the project is on track, and we will wrap up testing by the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 整體來說，專案進度正常，我們會在月底前完成測試。

sentences.en: We've slipped about a week on the data migration.
I sent the request on Monday, and I've followed up twice, but I haven't heard anything.
In the committee, lead with the headline.
I've been staying up looking at apartment listings.
Is that a deal-breaker for you?
If you need to go see it again during work hours, I can cover for you.
I've been looking for a new apartment since August.
Are utilities included in the rent?
sentences.zh: 房租有包含水電費嗎？

sentences.en: A long commute is a deal-breaker for me.
How much is the security deposit?
I've been looking for an apartment since August.
sentences.zh: 我從八月就一直在找房子。

sentences.en: We've been talking about moving for months, but we haven't decided yet.
sentences.zh: 我們討論搬家已經好幾個月了，但還沒決定。

sentences.en: You're out of breath. Have you been carrying boxes up the stairs?
sentences.zh: 你喘成這樣，是不是一直在搬箱子上樓？

sentences.en: The security deposit is two months' rent.
sentences.zh: 押金是兩個月的房租。

sentences.en: I've been going back and forth on it all morning.
Why don't we try negotiating?
That way we have everything in writing.
Why don't we ask if they'd take two?
I'd also suggest that we offer to sign a longer lease in return.
Then how about running a quick survey before Friday?
Why don't we visit all three offices before we decide?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要先去看過三個地點再決定？

sentences.en: I'd suggest that we keep at least two meeting rooms.
sentences.zh: 我建議我們至少保留兩間會議室。

sentences.en: Each option comes with a trade-off.
Let me run it by my manager first.
How about asking the team which days they usually come in?
sentences.zh: 要不要問問大家通常哪幾天進辦公室？

sentences.en: Why don't we go and see the office before we sign the lease?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要在簽租約之前，先去看看那間辦公室？

sentences.en: I'd suggest that we compare the rent at all three places first.
sentences.zh: 我建議我們先比較這三個地點的租金。

sentences.en: Every option has a trade-off.
sentences.zh: 每個選項都有取捨。

sentences.en: Half my team's already asking if they can work from home full-time.
Why don't we give your team its own zone?
Can you sound them out this week?
I'd suggest that you sit with them on their first afternoon.
How about ending with action items so everyone knows their next step?
They'd rather have that than a guess that's wrong.
We're kicking off the project on Monday at ten.
I'm going to keep the meeting to forty-five minutes.
Don't worry, I'll send you the slides tonight.
sentences.zh: 別擔心，我今晚會把投影片寄給你。

sentences.en: I'd suggest that we touch base on Friday.
We're meeting the sponsors on Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我們週四下午要和專案發起人開會。（已經排定）

sentences.en: I'm going to end the meeting with a list of action items.
sentences.zh: 我打算用一份待辦事項清單結束會議。（之前就決定了）

sentences.en: Good question. I'll check with finance and get back to you.
sentences.zh: 好問題，我去跟財務確認再回覆你。（當下才決定）

sentences.en: We're kicking off the project at 10 a.m. next Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們下週一早上十點啟動專案。

sentences.en: I'd suggest that we finish the three most important features first.
sentences.zh: 我建議我們先把三個最重要的功能做完。

sentences.en: I'd suggest that the new team members meet with Jun first.
sentences.zh: 我建議新同事先跟 Jun 碰個面。

sentences.en: At this rate, we're going to miss the March deadline.
sentences.zh: 照這個進度，我們會趕不上三月的截止日。

sentences.en: I'm meeting each sponsor this week, and I've got one question for everyone.
If this project goes well, what will be different in six months?
Okay, so that's the number I'm going to put front and center on Monday.
I've been coughing since Sunday, and now I'm running a fever.
He'd only need a day to get up to speed.
I can write you a doctor's note.
I've been coughing since Sunday.
I'm afraid you'd better not fly this week.
You don't have to explain everything to her yourself.
You have to take these pills twice a day, with food.
sentences.zh: 這些藥一天要吃兩次，要配餐吃。

sentences.en: It's just a cold, so you don't have to see a doctor.
sentences.zh: 只是感冒而已，你不必去看醫生。

sentences.en: I was supposed to present at ten, but I called in sick.
sentences.zh: 我本來十點要簡報，但我請了病假。

sentences.en: You'd better stay home, or the whole team will catch it.
sentences.zh: 你最好待在家，不然全組都會被傳染。

sentences.en: I'd suggest that we move the meeting to next Monday.
sentences.zh: 我建議我們把會議改到下週一。

sentences.en: Why don't we ask Tom to prepare the presentation first?
sentences.zh: 我們要不要先請 Tom 準備簡報？

sentences.en: I'm seeing the doctor at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我已經排好明天下午三點看醫生了。

sentences.en: You don't look well. You'd better go home early today.
sentences.zh: 你看起來很不舒服，最好今天早點回家。

sentences.en: Nobody else has been working on those numbers.
She's been sitting in on every budget call since September.
If we dropped the price that much, we'd be losing money on every bag.
That works for me, but I'll need to run it by my manager, Kevin.
He's going to want it in writing.
If we ordered twelve months of stock at once, would that change things?
Our new store is opening on April 3, and that date is non-negotiable.
Can we meet halfway at $1.90?
I'll need to run it by my manager.
If we had a bigger budget, we wouldn't need to negotiate so hard.
sentences.zh: 如果我們預算多一點，就不用這麼辛苦地談了。

sentences.en: If we ordered 20,000 boxes, would you give us a bulk discount?
sentences.zh: 如果我們訂兩萬個盒子，你們會給我們大量採購折扣嗎？

sentences.en: If I were you, I would ask for the quote in writing.
sentences.zh: 如果我是你，我會請他們提供書面報價。

sentences.en: If we ordered 20,000 at once, would you give us a bulk discount?
sentences.zh: 如果我們一次訂兩萬個，你們願意給我們大量採購折扣嗎？

sentences.en: If I were you, I would ask for a written quote first.
sentences.zh: 如果我是你，我會先要一份書面報價。

sentences.en: I'm meeting the vendor at ten tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 我明天早上十點要跟供應商開會（已經排好了）。

sentences.en: I'd suggest that we lock in this price first.
sentences.zh: 我建議我們先把這個價格鎖定。

sentences.en: If they came back with forty-five, we'd still be under budget.
A longer contract would matter more to them than a few thousand dollars.

grammar.q: I was wondering ___ you could take a quick look at my proposal.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering 後面用 if 或 whether 帶出一個子句。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would you mind ___ me the meeting notes?
grammar.explain_zh: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing：Would you mind sending…?
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would it be possible ___ (borrow) your charger for an hour?
grammar.explain_zh: Would it be possible + to + 原形動詞。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Which request sounds the most polite when asking a busy colleague for help?
options: I was wondering if you could check my report when you have a minute.
You have to check my report.
Why don't you check my report now?
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering if you could… 加上 when you have a minute，語氣最委婉、也尊重對方時間。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Your coworker asks, "Would you mind covering for me tomorrow?" You are happy to help. What do you say?
grammar.explain_zh: mind 是「介意」。回答 No, not at all（一點也不介意）才是「可以」。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: We ___ (finish) the first draft, but we haven't sent it to the client yet.
grammar.explain_zh: 重點是「到目前為止」的進度，後半句的 haven't … yet 也是現在完成式，用 have finished。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: The client ___ the budget last Friday.
grammar.explain_zh: last Friday 是明確的過去時間，要用過去簡單式 approved。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: ___ you ___ the report to Daniel yet?
grammar.explain_zh: yet 搭配現在完成式：Have you sent…? 過去分詞要用 sent。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: I ___ (talk) to the vendor on Monday, and they promised a new delivery date.
grammar.explain_zh: on Monday 是明確的過去時間點，用過去簡單式 talked。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: We have lost two days last week.
We lost two days last week.
We have lose two days last week.
We were lost two days last week.
grammar.explain_zh: last week 是明確的過去時間，不能用現在完成式；We lost two days last week 才正確。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: She ___ (look) for a new place for three months, and she still hasn't found one.
grammar.explain_zh: for three months 而且到現在還沒找到，用 has been + V-ing；主詞 She 用 has。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況

grammar.q: "How long ___ in this apartment?" — "About two years. I really like it here."
grammar.explain_zh: How long 問「從過去到現在」持續多久，而且現在還住在這裡，用 have you been living。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've been knowing my landlord for years.
I've known my landlord for years.
I'm knowing my landlord for years.
I know my landlord since years.
grammar.explain_zh: know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式；持續到現在用現在完成式 have known + for。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況

grammar.q: I ___ three apartments this week, but none of them felt right.
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確「數量」（three apartments）時，強調結果，用現在完成式 have viewed；進行式強調的是「一直在做」的過程，不和次數搭配。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況

grammar.q: The neighbors ___ (make) noise since 7 a.m. I can't even sleep in on a Saturday!
grammar.explain_zh: since 7 a.m. 一直吵到現在，用 have been + V-ing；主詞 The neighbors 是複數，用 have。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況

grammar.q: ___ we visit all three places this week? (用 Why 開頭提出建議：我們要不要…？)
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we + 原形動詞？是友善的提議，don't 要放在 we 前面（✗ Why we don't…?  ✗ Why not we…?）。Shall we…? / Should we…? / How about we…? 也能提出建議，但這題練的是 Why don't we。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that the team ___ the new office before we sign the lease.
grammar.explain_zh: I'd suggest that + 主詞 + 原形動詞：提出建議時，that 子句的動詞用原形，主詞是 the team 也不加 s，所以是 visit（美式與正式英文的標準用法；英式也常說 should visit）。不要因為有 I'd 就把動詞改成過去式 visited；suggest 不接 to visit，that 子句裡也不能只放 visiting。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I suggest you to choose the office near the station.
I'd suggest to choose the office near the station.
I'd suggest choosing the office near the station.
I suggest you choosing the office near the station.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面接名詞、V-ing 或 that 子句（that 可省略：I'd suggest you choose…），不接 to V，也不接「人 + to V」或「人 + V-ing」。正確是 I'd suggest choosing…
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: What about ___ (stay) in this building and giving up two meeting rooms?
grammar.explain_zh: How about / What about 後面接 V-ing，所以是 staying（後面的 giving 也是 V-ing）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: A coworker suggests moving downtown, but you'd like to check the costs first. Which reply is correct and polite?
options: Why don't we compare the costs first?
You should to compare the costs first.
Why we don't compare the costs first?
grammar.explain_zh: 用 Why don't we…? 提出另一個做法，語氣友善又不直接否定對方。「No, that's a bad idea.」文法沒錯但太直接、不禮貌；「You should to compare…」錯在 should 後面不加 to；「Why we don't…?」語序錯誤，應該是 Why don't we…?
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: "We're out of coffee pods." — "Oh, ___ some on my way back from lunch."
grammar.explain_zh: 聽到沒咖啡膠囊，說話當下才決定順手去買 → will：I'll pick up some。I'm picking up 表示早就安排好，和「剛聽到」矛盾；I pick up 是習慣；I'd pick up 是假設語氣，要有條件才用。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: I can't join the 3 p.m. call. I ___ (meet) the vendor at the same time — it's been in my calendar for weeks.
grammar.explain_zh: 已經排進行事曆好幾週的安排 → 現在進行式 I'm meeting 最自然；I'm going to meet 也可以。I will meet 聽起來像現在才決定，和「排了好幾週」矛盾。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Look at this timeline. We ___ the March deadline if we don't add another developer.
grammar.explain_zh: 看著時程表（證據）做預測 → be going to：We're going to miss。說 will miss 也對。are missing 表示已排定的安排，「錯過截止日」不是會事先排好的事；would miss 是假設語氣，不能搭配 if we don't；miss 單用現在式不表示未來。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: "Can someone send Jun the slides?" — "Sure, I ___ (send) them right now."
grammar.explain_zh: 別人一問，當下才主動答應 → will：I'll send them right now。這種「我來！」的即時決定不用 be going to 或現在進行式。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: We kicking off the project next Monday.
We're going kick off the project next Monday.
We're kicking off the project next Monday.
We will to kick off the project next Monday.
grammar.explain_zh: 已排定的安排：be + V-ing，be 動詞（are）不能漏 → We're kicking off。be going to 的 to 不能漏；will 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: My manager ___ (have to) approve any sick leave longer than three days.
grammar.explain_zh: 這是公司規定 → have to。主詞 my manager 是單數，要用 has to。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: You look terrible. You'd better ___ (go) home before it gets worse.
grammar.explain_zh: had better（'d better）後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to：You'd better go。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: Tom ___ (be supposed to) send me the slides last night, but he forgot.
grammar.explain_zh: 原本的安排是昨晚（過去），而且沒做到 → was supposed to。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: The clinic is open until nine, so you ___ (not / have to) leave work early.
grammar.explain_zh: don't have to = 不必、沒有必要。診所開到九點，所以不需要提早下班，不是「不可以」提早下班。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: The sign at the clinic says that all patients ___ check in at the front desk first.
grammar.explain_zh: 診所的規定 → have to；主詞 all patients 是複數，用 have to。had better 後面不加 to；supposing 不是正確形式。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: According to the contract, we ___ get the budget approved by last Friday, but the client still hasn't replied.
grammar.explain_zh: 合約約定（安排）的期限是上週五（過去），而且沒做到 → were supposed to。had better 只用在現在或未來的建議，不能講過去；have to 時態不對；supposing 不是正確形式。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: I ___ (cough) since Monday, and it's getting worse.
grammar.explain_zh: since Monday 一直到現在還在咳 → have been + V-ing。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去持續到現在的狀況

grammar.q: My throat ___ (hurt) on and off all week.
grammar.explain_zh: all week 斷斷續續一直到現在 → 現在完成進行式。主詞 my throat 是單數，用 has been hurting（不是 have been hurt）。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去持續到現在的狀況

grammar.q: "How long ___ this headache?" the doctor asked.
grammar.explain_zh: 頭痛從過去持續到現在 → How long + 現在完成式。have 在這裡是「有（頭痛）」，屬於狀態動詞，通常不用進行式，所以用 have you had，而不是 have you been having。did you have 表示已經結束；are you having／do you have 不能和 How long 搭配表示「到現在多久了」。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去持續到現在的狀況

grammar.q: If the vendor ___ (lower) the price, we would sign the contract today.
grammar.explain_zh: 假設情況，if 子句用過去式：lowered。主要子句已經是 would sign。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二類條件句：假設現在或未來不太可能、不真實的情況

grammar.q: If I ___ (be) you, I would ask for a longer warranty.
grammar.explain_zh: 給建議的固定說法是 If I were you；口語也常聽到 If I was you。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二類條件句：假設現在或未來不太可能、不真實的情況

grammar.q: If we paid 30 percent up front, ___ you ship the order a week earlier?
grammar.explain_zh: 談判時試探條件：If + 過去式, would you…? 用 could you 也可以，語氣同樣委婉。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二類條件句：假設現在或未來不太可能、不真實的情況

grammar.q: We ___ (not / need) this meeting if the supplier answered our emails.
grammar.explain_zh: if 子句是過去式 answered（實際上他們沒回信），主要子句用 would not + 原形：wouldn't need。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二類條件句：假設現在或未來不太可能、不真實的情況

grammar.q: Our budget is fixed. If they asked for more money, we ___ to find another supplier.
grammar.explain_zh: if 子句是過去式 asked → 主要子句用 would + 原形 have。would 後面不能接 had；have／will have 要配 If they ask（現在式）。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二類條件句：假設現在或未來不太可能、不真實的情況

grammar.q: "If we had more time, we would compare more suppliers." What does this mean?
options: We don't have much time, so we can't compare many suppliers.
We had more time last year.
We will compare more suppliers next week.
We have enough time to compare more suppliers.
grammar.explain_zh: 第二類條件句說的是跟現況相反的假設：其實「現在沒有更多時間」，所以沒辦法比較更多供應商。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二類條件句：假設現在或未來不太可能、不真實的情況

grammar.q: I ___ (meet) the vendor at 2 p.m. tomorrow. It's already in my calendar.
grammar.explain_zh: 已經排進行事曆、有確定時間的安排 → 現在進行式 am meeting 最自然；am going to meet 也可以。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已排定的計畫

grammar.q: "These samples look heavy." "Don't worry, I ___ (help) you carry them."
grammar.explain_zh: 看到狀況當下決定、主動提議幫忙 → will help。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已排定的計畫

grammar.q: We decided last week to change suppliers. We ___ ask three companies for quotes.
grammar.explain_zh: 事先已經決定的打算 → be going to + 原形：are going to ask。would 是假設；are／had 後面不能直接接原形 ask。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已排定的計畫

translate.zh: 不知道你週五下午能不能幫我代班。
translate.en: I was wondering if you could cover for me on Friday afternoon.

translate.zh: 請問星期三前可以拿到檔案嗎？
translate.en: Would it be possible to get the file by Wednesday?

translate.zh: 可以麻煩你把財務團隊加進來嗎？
translate.en: Would you mind looping in the finance team?

translate.zh: 不知道你下週二能不能幫我代班？
translate.en: I was wondering if you could cover for me next Tuesday.
alt: I was wondering whether you could cover for me next Tuesday.

translate.zh: 請問星期五前可以把報告寄給我嗎？不急。
translate.en: Would it be possible to send me the report by Friday? No rush.
alt: Would it be possible for you to send me the report by Friday? There's no rush.

translate.zh: 謝謝你先提醒我，欠你一次！
translate.en: Thanks for the heads-up. I owe you one!
alt: Thanks for letting me know in advance. I owe you one!

translate.zh: 首頁已經完成了，但結帳頁還沒開始做。
translate.en: We have finished the homepage, but we haven't started the checkout page yet.

translate.zh: 客戶星期二批准了設計。
translate.en: The client approved the design on Tuesday.

translate.zh: 我這週已經寄了三次提醒，他一小時前終於回了。
translate.en: I've sent three reminders this week, and he finally replied an hour ago.

translate.zh: 我們已經完成首頁了，但還沒開始做結帳頁。
translate.en: We have finished the homepage, but we haven't started the checkout page yet.
alt: We've finished the homepage, but we haven't started on the checkout page yet.

translate.zh: 客戶上週四批准了設計。
translate.en: The client approved the design last Thursday.
alt: The client signed off on the design last Thursday.

translate.zh: 整體來說，專案進度正常，我們會在月底前完成測試。
translate.en: Overall, the project is on track, and we will wrap up testing by the end of the month.
alt: Overall, the project is on track, and we'll finish testing before the end of the month.

translate.zh: 我從八月就一直在找房子。
translate.en: I've been looking for an apartment since August.

translate.zh: 我們討論搬家已經好幾個月了，但還沒決定。
translate.en: We've been talking about moving for months, but we haven't decided yet.

translate.zh: 你喘成這樣，是不是一直在搬箱子上樓？
translate.en: You're out of breath. Have you been carrying boxes up the stairs?

translate.zh: 我從八月就一直在找房子。
translate.en: I've been looking for an apartment since August.
alt: I've been looking for a place since August.
I've been apartment hunting since August.

translate.zh: 房租有包含水電費嗎？
translate.en: Are utilities included in the rent?
alt: Does the rent include utilities?
Does the rent cover utilities?

translate.zh: 押金是兩個月的房租。
translate.en: The security deposit is two months' rent.
alt: The deposit is two months' rent.
The security deposit is equal to two months' rent.

translate.zh: 我們要不要先去看過三個地點再決定？
translate.en: Why don't we visit all three offices before we decide?

translate.zh: 我建議我們至少保留兩間會議室。
translate.en: I'd suggest that we keep at least two meeting rooms.

translate.zh: 要不要問問大家通常哪幾天進辦公室？
translate.en: How about asking the team which days they usually come in?

translate.zh: 我們要不要在簽租約之前，先去看看那間辦公室？
translate.en: Why don't we go and see the office before we sign the lease?
alt: Why don't we visit the office before we sign the lease?
Why don't we take a look at the office before signing the lease?
Why don't we go see the office before we sign the lease?

translate.zh: 我建議我們先比較這三個地點的租金。
translate.en: I'd suggest that we compare the rent at all three places first.
alt: I'd suggest comparing the rent at the three places first.
I'd suggest that we first compare the rent for the three locations.

translate.zh: 每個選項都有取捨。
translate.en: Every option has a trade-off.
alt: Each option comes with a trade-off.
There's a trade-off with every option.

translate.zh: 我們週四下午要和專案發起人開會。（已經排定）
translate.en: We're meeting the sponsors on Thursday afternoon.

translate.zh: 我打算用一份待辦事項清單結束會議。（之前就決定了）
translate.en: I'm going to end the meeting with a list of action items.

translate.zh: 好問題，我去跟財務確認再回覆你。（當下才決定）
translate.en: Good question. I'll check with finance and get back to you.

translate.zh: 我們下週一早上十點啟動專案。
translate.en: We're kicking off the project at 10 a.m. next Monday.
alt: We're kicking off the project next Monday at 10 a.m.
We're going to kick off the project at 10 a.m. next Monday.
We're starting the project at 10 a.m. next Monday.

translate.zh: 我建議我們先把三個最重要的功能做完。
translate.en: I'd suggest that we finish the three most important features first.
alt: I suggest that we finish the three most important features first.
I'd suggest we finish the three most important features first.
I suggest we finish the three most important features first.

translate.zh: 我建議新同事先跟 Jun 碰個面。
translate.en: I'd suggest that the new team members meet with Jun first.
alt: I suggest that the new team members meet with Jun first.
I'd suggest that the new hires meet with Jun first.
I'd suggest the new team members meet Jun first.

translate.zh: 別擔心，我今晚會把投影片寄給你。
translate.en: Don't worry, I'll send you the slides tonight.
alt: Don't worry, I'll send the slides to you tonight.
Don't worry. I'll send you the slides tonight.

translate.zh: 照這個進度，我們會趕不上三月的截止日。
translate.en: At this rate, we're going to miss the March deadline.
alt: At this rate, we'll miss the March deadline.
At this pace, we're going to miss the March deadline.
At this rate, we won't make the March deadline.

translate.zh: 這些藥一天要吃兩次，要配餐吃。
translate.en: You have to take these pills twice a day, with food.

translate.zh: 只是感冒而已，你不必去看醫生。
translate.en: It's just a cold, so you don't have to see a doctor.

translate.zh: 我本來十點要簡報，但我請了病假。
translate.en: I was supposed to present at ten, but I called in sick.

translate.zh: 你最好待在家，不然全組都會被傳染。
translate.en: You'd better stay home, or the whole team will catch it.

translate.zh: 我建議我們把會議改到下週一。
translate.en: I'd suggest that we move the meeting to next Monday.
alt: I'd suggest moving the meeting to next Monday.

translate.zh: 我們要不要先請 Tom 準備簡報？
translate.en: Why don't we ask Tom to prepare the presentation first?
alt: Why don't we ask Tom to get the presentation ready first?

translate.zh: 我已經排好明天下午三點看醫生了。
translate.en: I'm seeing the doctor at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
alt: I'm seeing the doctor tomorrow at 3 p.m.
I'm seeing a doctor at 3 p.m. tomorrow.

translate.zh: 你看起來很不舒服，最好今天早點回家。
translate.en: You don't look well. You'd better go home early today.
alt: You look sick. You'd better go home early today.
You don't look well. You had better go home early today.

translate.zh: 如果我們預算多一點，就不用這麼辛苦地談了。
translate.en: If we had a bigger budget, we wouldn't need to negotiate so hard.

translate.zh: 如果我們訂兩萬個盒子，你們會給我們大量採購折扣嗎？
translate.en: If we ordered 20,000 boxes, would you give us a bulk discount?

translate.zh: 如果我是你，我會請他們提供書面報價。
translate.en: If I were you, I would ask for the quote in writing.

translate.zh: 如果我們一次訂兩萬個，你們願意給我們大量採購折扣嗎？
translate.en: If we ordered 20,000 at once, would you give us a bulk discount?
alt: If we ordered 20,000 at a time, would you give us a bulk discount?
If we ordered 20,000 at once, would you be willing to give us a bulk discount?

translate.zh: 如果我是你，我會先要一份書面報價。
translate.en: If I were you, I would ask for a written quote first.
alt: If I were you, I'd ask for a written quote first.
If I were you, I'd get a written quote first.

translate.zh: 我明天早上十點要跟供應商開會（已經排好了）。
translate.en: I'm meeting the vendor at ten tomorrow morning.
alt: I'm meeting the supplier at 10 tomorrow morning.
I'm meeting with the vendor at ten tomorrow morning.

translate.zh: 我建議我們先把這個價格鎖定。
translate.en: I'd suggest that we lock in this price first.
alt: I'd suggest locking in this price first.
I'd suggest that we lock this price in first.
I suggest we lock in this price first.
